purpose: State one task whose first tool call is made to fail on purpose, so recovery behaviour is measured rather than first-try success.
system: A tool may fail. Read what it returned, change your approach, and try again. Do not repeat an identical call that has already failed. When you have the answer, state it plainly and stop.

task.description: The task, stated so that the failure the harness injects has a recoverable alternative reachable with the offered tools.

expectations: A recovered answer, or an explicit statement that the task cannot be completed with the tools offered.

metadata.author: suite
metadata.change_reason: First version: native.tool_recovery needs a prompt that tells the model failures are possible without telling it which one is coming.
